songs.title: Amazing grace! how sweet the sound

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
1. Amazing grace! how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me!
I once was lost, but now I’m found
Was blind but now I see

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
2. ’Twas grace that taught my heart to fear,

And grace my fears relieved;
How precious did that grace appear,
The hour I first believed!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
3. Thro’ many dangers, toils, and snares,
I have already come;
Tis grace hath brought me safe thus Far,
And grace will lead me home.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
4. The Lord has promised good to me
His word my hope secures.
He will my shield and portion be As long as life endures.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
5 And when this flesh and heart shall fail
And mortal life shall cease
I shall possess within the veil
A life of joy and peace.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
6. When we’ve been there ten thousand years,
Bright shining as the sun,

We’ve no less days to sing

God’s grace,
Than when we first began.

sections.content:
2. 'Tis mystery all! The

immortal dies!

Who can explore his strange

design?

In vain the first born seraph tries
To sound the depth of love divine

Let angel-minds inquire no

more.

light;

thee.

So grand!

Away far over Jordan

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
1. Be gone, unbelief,

My saviour is near,

And for my relief

Will surely appear;
By prayer let me wrestle,
And He will perform;

With Christ in the vessel,
I smile at the storm.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
2. Though dark be my way,
Since He is my Guide,
‘Tis mine to obey,

‘Tis His to provide;
Though cisterns be broken,
And creatures all fail,
The word He has spoken
Shall surely prevail

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
3. His love in time past,
Forbids me to think
He’ll leave me at last
In trouble to sink:
While each Ebenezer
I have in review
Confirms His good pleasure
To help me quite through

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
4. Why should I complain
Of want or distress,
Temptation or pain?

He told me no less;
The heirs of salvation,

I know from His Word,

Through much tribulation

Must follow their Lord

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
5. How bitter that cup
No heart can conceive,
Which He drank quite up,
That sinners might live!
His way was much rougher
And darker than mine;

Did Christ, my Lord, suffer,
And shall I repine?

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
6. Since all that I meet
Shall work for my good,
The bitter is sweet,
The medicine, food;
Though painful at present,
‘T will cease before long,
And then, oh, how pleasant
The conqueror’s song!

Be steadfast and Immovable
Abounding in the work of the Lord
Your labour won’t be in vain
And your reward will be great.
Translation of “Montintim, mma monhinhim da”

Hallelujah to the Lamb!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
I have passed the outer veil,
Hallelujah to the Lamb!
Which did once God’s light conceal
O glory be to God!
But the blood has brought me in To God’s holiness so clean,

Where there’s death to self and sin,

Hallelujah to the Lamb!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
I’m within the holiest pale,
Hallelujah to the Lamb!
I have passed the inner veil,
O glory be to God!
I am sanctified to God
By the power of the blood,
Now the Lord is my abode
Hallelujah to the Lamb!

If you would serve the Lord a-right,
Spend some time in pray'r
If you would keep your armour bright
Spend some time in pray'r

Pray'r, its value none can measure,
It will bring you lasting treasure;
Present help and present pleasure
Spend some time in pray'r

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
If you would daily do His will,
Spend some time in pray'r.
For strength, his bidding to fulfil,
Spend some time in pray'r.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
For pow’r to run the Christian race,
Spend some time in pray'r
Come often to the throne of grace,
Spend some time in pray'r

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
God only can your needs supply,
Spend some time in pray'r
The blessings cometh from on high,
Spend some time in pray'r

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Immortal, Invisible God only wise
In light inaccessible hid from our eyes
Most blessed, most glorious,
The Ancient of Days
Almighty, victorious,
Thy great name we praise

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Unresting, unhasting,
And silent as light
Nor wanting, nor wasting,
Thou rulest in might
Thy justice like mountains high soaring above,
Thy clouds which are fountains of goodness and love

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
To all life Thou givest – to both great and small
In all life Thou livest, the true life of all;
We blossom and flourish as leaves on the tree,
And wither and perish – but nought changeth thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Great father of Glory,
Pure Father of light
Thine angels adore Thee,
All veiling their sight;
All laud we would render,
O help us to see:
‘Tis only the splendour of light hideth Thee

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Immortal, Invisible,
God only wise,
In light inaccessible hid from our eyes
Most blessed, most glorious;
The Ancient of Days
Almighty, victorious,
Thy great name we praise

songs.title: In My Heart I Will Praise the Lord

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
In my heart (x3)
I will praise the Lord
For His goodness for His kindness
His faithfulness ever sure
In my heart (x3)

I will praise the Lord

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
In our dear Lord’s garden,
Planted here below,
Many tiny flowerets
In sweet beauty grow

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Christ, the loving Gardener,
Tends these blossoms small;
Loves the little lilies
As the cedars tall

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Nothing is too little
For His gentle care;
Nothing is too lowly
In His love to share

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Jesus loves the children,
Children such as we;

Blest them when their mothers
Brought them to His knee

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Jesus calls the children,
Bids them come and stand
In His pleasant garden,
Watered by His hand

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Lord, Thy call we answer
Take us in Thy care;
Train us in Thy garden,
In Thy work to share

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
In the same old way, in the same old way
The Lord is doing business in the same old way;
In the same old way, in the same old way,
The Lord is doing business in the same old way.

In Times Like These
You need a Saviour
In times like these
You need an Anchor
Be very sure
Be very sure
Your anchor holds

Yes He’s the One
This Rock is Jesus

Be very sure

Into my heart, into my heart,
Come into my heart, Lord
Jesus

songs.title: Is There a Heart That Is Waiting

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Is there a heart that is waiting
Longing for pardon today?
Hear the glad message proclaiming
Jesus is passing this way

Jesus is passing this way
This way, this way
Jesus is passing this way
He is passing this way today

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Is there a heart that has wandered?

Come with thy burden today;
Mercy is tenderly passing
Jesus is passing this way

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Is there a heart that is broken
Weary and sighing for rest?
Come to the arms of thy Saviour,
Pillow thy head on his Breast

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Come to thy only Redeemer
Come to His infinite love,
Come to the gate that is leading
Homeward to mansion above

songs.title: Is There Anybody Here That Loves My Jesus?

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Is there anybody here that loves my Jesus?
Anybody here that loves my Lord?
I want to know, I want to know if you love my Lord.
My soul is happy when I love my Jesus
My soul is happy when I love my Lord,
I want to know, I want to know if you love my Lord

songs.title: It Is No Longer I That Liveth

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
It is no longer I that liveth, but Christ that liveth in me
It is no longer I that liveth, but
Christ that liveth in me
He lives, He lives, Christ
Jesus is alive in me
It is no longer I that liveth, but
Christ that liveth in me.

songs.title: I'll Go Where You Want Me to Go

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
It may not be on the mountain's height
Or over the stormy sea;
It may not be at the battle front
My Lord will have need of me;
But if by a still small voice
He calls
To paths I do not know
I'll answer, dear Lord, with my hand in Thine
I'll go where you want me to go

I'll go where you want me to go dear Lord
O'er mountain, or plain or sea;
I'll say what you want me to say, dear Lord
I'll be what you want me to be

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Perhaps today there are loving words
Which Jesus would have me to speak;
There may be now, in the paths of sin,
Some wand'rer whom I should seek,
O Saviour, if thou wilt be my Guide
Tho' dark and rugged the way,
My voice shall echo the message sweet
I'll say what you want me to say

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
There's surely somewhere a lowly place
In earth's harvest-fields so wide
Where I may labour thro’ life's short day
For Jesus, the Crucified.
So, trusting my all unto Thy care,
I know Thou lovest me!
I'll do Thy will with a heart sincere,

I'll be what you want me to be.

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
It will come to pass
All His promises
They will come to pass, says the Lord Pray every day Believe in the word
For there is joy, fullness of joy

songs.title: It's Not by Our Strength, but by Your Strength

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
It’s not by our strength, but
by Your strength
Power of the Holy Ghost
Performs wondrous works

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Not our righteousness, but
Your own!
By the Holy Spirit moved,
The good fruit we bear.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
O Holy Spirit, Spirit
Divine
Daily strength we ask of You

To Christ glorify

At your mercies, Lord

Your will be done

Jehovah, blessed be Your Name

songs.title: Jesus Calls Us, O'er the Tumult

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus calls us, o'er the tumult
Of our life's wild, restless sea;

Day by day His sweet voice soundeth
Saying, "Christian, follow Me;"

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
As of old, apostles heard it
By the Galilean lake,
Turned from home and toil and kindred,
Leaving all for His dear sake.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Jesus calls us from the worship
Of the vain world's golden store;
From each idol that would keep us,
Saying, "Christian, love Me more."

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
In our joys and in our sorrows,
Days of toil and hours of ease,
Still He calls, in cares and pleasures,
"Christian, love Me more than these."

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Jesus calls us: by Thy mercies,
Saviour, may we hear Thy call,
Give our hearts to Thy obedience,
Serve and love Thee best of all.

songs.title: Jesus Christ, I Come to You

sections.label: Verse
Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus Christ is Wonderful
Counsellor, God Almighty,
Eternal Father, Prince of peace;
We shall glorify His Name

Blessed is He, Blessed is He
Blessed is our God;
Blessed, blessed, blessed is our God

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, Friend of my soul
Drawing me close to know
The loving Father’s desire
That keeps on seeking me

If I really meet You
I will worship You in truth
Worship You in Spirit
Never turn You down

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Jesus Friend of my soul
I’m searching for You
Yet You are with me
Help me know You are close

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Jesus, Friend of my soul
No longer I hear You
Help me clearly discern
You are always with me.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Jesus, Friend of my soul

Has drawn me to Eternal God

I’ve known the depth of Your love
In joy I’ll worship You

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
Jesus, how lovely you are!
You are so gentle, so pure
and so kind;
You shine like the morning star:
Jesus, how lovely you are!

songs.title: Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, I my cross have taken,
All to leave and follow Thee.
Destitute, despised, forsaken,
Thou from hence my all shall be.
Perish every fond ambition,
All I’ve sought or hoped or known.
Yet how rich is my condition!
God and heaven are still my own

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Let the world despise and leave me,
They have left my Saviour, too.
Human hearts and looks deceive me;
Thou art not, like them, untrue.
O while Thou dost smile
upon me,
God of wisdom, love, and might,
Foes may hate and friends disown me,
Show Thy face and all is bright.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Man may trouble and distress me,
’Twill but drive me to Thy breast
Life with trials hard may press me;
Heaven will bring me sweeter
rest.
Oh, ’tis not in grief to harm me
While Thy love is left to me;
Oh, ’t’were not in joy to charm me,
Were that joy unmixed with Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Go, then, earthly fame and treasure,
Come disaster, scorn and pain
In Thy service, pain is pleasure,
With Thy favor, loss is gain

I have called Thee Abba
Father,
I have stayed my heart on Thee
Storms may howl, and clouds may gather;
All must work for good to me.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Soul, then know thy full salvation
Rise o’er sin and fear and care
Joy to find in every station,
Something still to do or bear.
Think what Spirit dwells within thee,
Think what Father’s smiles are thine,
Think that Jesus died to win thee,
Child of heaven, canst thou repine.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Haste thee on from grace to glory,
Armed by faith, and winged by prayer.
Heaven’s eternal days before thee,
God’s own hand shall guide us there.
Soon shall close thy earthly mission,
Soon shall pass thy pilgrim days,
Hope shall change to glad fruition,

Faith to sight, and prayer to praise.

Wonderful King

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus is Lord!
Creation's voice proclaims it
For by his power
Each tree and flower
Was planned and made
Jesus is Lord! The universe declares it
Sun, moon and stars in heaven cry;
Jesus is Lord!

Jesus is Lord, Jesus is Lord!
Praise him with Alleluias
For Jesus is Lord

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Jesus is Lord!
Yet from his throne eternal
In flesh he came
To die in pain
On Calvary's tree
Jesus is Lord!
From him all life proceeding
He gave his life a ransom thus setting us free.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Jesus is Lord!
O'er sin the mighty conqueror
From death he rose

And all his foes
shall own his name

Jesus is Lord! God sent his
Holy Spirit
To show by works of power that Jesus is Lord!

songs.title: Jesus Is the Bread of Life

sections.label: Chorus
Chorus
sections.content:
Jesus! Jesus, my Saviour,
You are King of kings indeed!
Jesus! Jesus, my Saviour,
You are King of kings indeed!

songs.title: Jesus, Keep Me Near the Cross

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, keep me near the cross
There a precious fountain,

Free to all, a healing stream,

Flows from Calv'ry's mountain.

In the cross, (x2)
Be my glory ever,
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Near the cross, a trembling soul,
Love and mercy found me;
There the bright and morning star
Shed its beams around me.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Near the Cross! O Lamb of God,
Bring its scenes before me;
Help me walk from day to day,
With its shadow o’er me

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Near the cross I'll watch and wait,
Hoping, trusting ever,
Till I reach the golden strand,
Just beyond the river.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, let me ever be Firmly grounded upon thee
Ever in thy work abide,
Ever in thy wounds reside.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.content:
Anger I no more shall feel,
Always even, always still
Meekly on my God reclined
Jesu's is a gentle mind.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
I shall suffer and fulfil
All my father's gracious will,
Be in all alike resigned;
Jesu's is a patient mind

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
When ‘tis deeply rooted here;
Perfect love shall cast out fear,
Fear doth servile spirits bind,
Jesu’s is a noble mind.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
I shall nothing know beside
Jesus, and Him crucified;
Perfectly to Him be joined
Jesu’s is a loving mind

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.content:
I shall triumph evermore,
Gratefully my God adore
God so good, so true, so kind,
Jesu’s is a thankful mind.

sections.label: Verse 8
sections.content:
Lowly, loving, meek and pure
I shall to the end endure
Be no more to sin inclined;
Jesu’s is a constant mind.

sections.label: Verse 9
sections.content:
I shall fully be restored to the image of my Lord,

witnessing to all mankind,
Jesu’s is a perfect mind

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the nearer waters roll,
While the tempest still is high
Hide me, O my saviour, hide
Till the storm of life is past
Safe into the haven guide;
Oh, receive my soul at last.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Other refuge have I none
Hangs my helpless soul on thee;
Leave, ah! Leave me not alone,
Still support and comfort me
All my trust on thee is stayed
All my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenceless head
With the shadow of Thy wing.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Thou, O Christ! art all I want
More than all in thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
Heal the sick, and lead the
blind
Just and holy is Thy name
I am all unrighteousness;

Vile and full of sin I am,
Thou art full of truth and grace.

sections.label: Verse 4

songs.title: Jesus, My King, My Wonderful Saviour

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, my King, my wonderful Saviour,
All of my life is given to thee.
I am rejoicing in thy salvation;
Thy precious blood now maketh me free.

Wonderful Saviour, wonderful Saviour,
Thou art so dear, so precious to me!
Wonderful Saviour,
wonderful Saviour,

My heart is full with praises to Thee!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Freedom from sin, o wonderful story –
All of its stains washed whiter as snow!
Jesus has come to live in His temple,
And with His love my heart is aglow.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Jesus, my Lord, I’ll ever adore Thee,

Lay at Thy feet my treasures
of love.
Lead me in ways to show forth Thy glory,
Ways that will end in heaven above.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
When in that bright and beautiful city
I shall behold thy glories untold,
I shall be like Thee,
wonderful Saviour,
And I will sing while ages unfold

songs.title: Jesus, My Saviour, Came from on High

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, my Saviour, came from on high
To die for you, to die for me;
Sinful, unworthy though I may be,
All this He did for me.

Wonderful story, how can it be?
Jesus has died for me and for you:
He left His crown and His
throne
All this He did for me.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Where the bright angels e’er sing His praise,
Round the white throne, round the white throne
Me from the depths, He came down to raise,
Claiming me as His own.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
What can I do my Lord to repay?
On Calvary’s tree, dying for me:
I’ll trust Thee, Lord, and e’er faithful be:

This I will do for Thee.

Beautiful Saviour
Glorious Lord
Emmanuel, God is with us

Living Word

fullness
Filling all our hearts within

sections.label: Verse 4

sections.label: Verse 6

For Jesus we are waiting

Listening for the trumpet’s sound

Living ever with our God.

songs.title: Jesus, See Me at Thy Feet

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus, see me at thy feet,
Nothing but thy blood can
save me;
Thou alone my need canst meet,
Nothing but thy blood can save me
No! No! Nothing do I bring,
But by faith I’m clinging,
To thy cross, O lamb of God!
Nothing but thy blood can save me

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
See my heart, Lord torn with grief,
Nothing but thy blood can save me;
Me unpardoned do not leave,
Nothing but thy blood can save me.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Dark, indeed, the past has been,
Nothing, but thy blood can save me,
Yet in mercy take me in Nothing but thy blood can save me.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
As I am, O, hear me pray,
Nothing but thy blood can save me;
I can ne’er remove a stain
Nothing but thy blood can save me.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Lord, I cast myself on thee,

Nothing but thy blood can save me;
From my guilt, O set me free

Nothing but thy blood can save me,

songs.title: Jesus Shall Reign Where'er the Sun

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Jesus shall reign where’er the sun
Doth his successive journeys run;
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore
Till suns shall rise and set no more

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.content:
People and realms of every tongue
Dwell on His love with sweetest song;

And infant voices shall proclaim

Their young hosannas to His
Name

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Blessings abound where’er he reigns,
The prisoner leaps to loose his chains.
The weary find eternal rest,
And all the sons of want are blest.

sections.label: Verse 5
Verse 6
sections.content:
Let every creature rise and bring,
Its grateful honours to our King:
Angels descend with songs again,
And earth prolong the joyful strain.

Jesus, stand among us
In Thy risen power,

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Breathe Thy Holy Spirit
Into every heart;
Bid the fears and sorrows
From each soul depart

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Thus with quickened footsteps
We’ll pursue our way,
Watching for the dawning
Of eternal day

Hold my hand commune with

me.

Translation of “me kra repre”
Grace Gakpetor

songs.title: My soul, rejoice and praise the Lord

sections.content:
My soul, rejoice and praise the

Lord
Rejoice and praise the Lord,
My soul, rejoice and praise the Lord
Rejoice and praise the Lord

Rejoice and praise the Lord
Rejoice and praise the Lord
My soul, rejoice and praise the Lord,

Rejoice and praise the Lord

PH 255

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Nearer, my God to thee,
Nearer to thee;
E'en though it be a cross
That raiseth me,
Still all my song shall be,
Nearer my God to thee,
Nearer to thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Though, like the wanderer,
The sun gone down,
Darkness be over me,
My rest a stone,

Yet in my dreams l'd be

Nearer, my God to thee,

Nearer to thee!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
There let the way appear
Steps unto heaven;

All that thou send'st to me
In mercy given;
Angels to beckon me
Nearer, my God, to thee
Nearer to thee!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Then, with my waking thoughts
Bright with thy praise
Out of my stony griefs
Bethel l'll raise;
So by my woes to be Nearer, my God, to thee

Nearer to thee!

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Or if on joyful wing
Cleaving the sky,
Sun, moon, and stars forgot,
Upwards I fly,
Still all my songs shall be Nearer, my God, to thee Nearer to thee!

sections.label: Attribution
sections.content: RH. 400, Sarah F. Adams

songs.title: Now I feel the sacred fire

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Now I feel the sacred fire,
Kindling, flaming, glowing
Higher still, and rising higher,
All my soul o’er flowing
Life immortal I receive;
Oh, the wondrous story!
I was dead, but now I live,
Glory! Glory! Glory!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Now I am from bondage freed
Every bond is riven
Jesus makes me free indeed,

Just as free as heaven;
‘Tis a glorious liberty,
Oh, the wondrous story;
I was bound, but now I’m free
Glory! Glory! Glory!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Let the testimony roll,
Roll through every nation
Witnessing from soul to soul
This immense salvation
Now I know it’s full and free
Oh, the wondrous story!
For I feel it saving me
Glory! glory! glory!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Glory be to God on high
Glory be to Jesus
He hath brought salvation nigh
From all sin He frees us;
Let the golden harps of God,
Ring the wondrous story;
Let the pilgrims shout aloud
Glory! Glory! Glory!

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Let the trump of jubilee
The glad tidings thunder,
Jesus sets the captives free,
Bursts their bonds asunder,
Fetters break and dungeons fall
Oh, the wondrous story

This salvation’s free to all

Glory! Glory! Glory!

sections.label: Attribution
sections.content: RH 216

songs.title: Now thank we all our God

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Now thank we all our God.
With hearts, and hands, and voices;
Who wondrous things hath done

In whom His world rejoices;
Who, from our mothers’ arms
Hath blessed us on our way
With countless gifts of love
And still is ours to-day

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
O may this bounteous God
Through all our life be near us,
With ever-joyful hearts
And blessed peace to cheer us,
And keep us in His grace,
And guide us when perplexed,
And free us from all ills
In this world and the next

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
All praise and thanks to God
The Father now be given,
The Son, and Him who reigns
With them in highest heaven
The one, eternal God
Whom earth and heaven adore;
For thus it was, is now
And shall be evermore.

sections.label: Attribution
sections.content:
Martin Rincart
Trans: Catherine Winkworth
RH 50

songs.title: Now the labourer’s task is o’er

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Now the labourer’s task is

o’er,
Now the battle-day is past;
Now upon the farther shore
Lands the voyager at last.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.content:
There the Shepherd, bringing home
Many a lamb forlorn and strayed,
Shelters each, no more to roam,
Where the wolf can ne’er invade

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
There the penitents who turn
To the cross their dying eyes
All the love of Jesus learn
At His feet in paradise

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
There no more the powers of hell
Can prevail to mar their peace;
Christ the Lord shall guard them well
He who died for their release

songs.title: Now the labourer's task is o’er

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Now the labourer’s task is o’er,
Now the battle-day is past;
Now upon the farther shore
Lands the voyager at last.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.content:
There the Shepherd, bringing home
Many a lamb forlorn and strayed,
Shelters each, no more to roam,
Where the wolf can ne’er invade

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
There the penitents who turn
To the cross their dying eyes
All the love of Jesus learn
At His feet in paradise

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
There no more the powers of hell
Can prevail to mar their peace;
Christ the Lord shall guard them well
He who died for their release

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Earth to earth, and dust to dust!
Calmly now the words we say;
Left behind, we wait in trust
For the resurrection day

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
O, come, all ye faithful
Joyful and triumphant
Come ye, O come ye to Bethlehem;
Come and behold him
Born the King of angels:
O come, let us adore him
O come, let us adore him
O come, let us adore him
Christ the Lord!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
True God of true God
Light of light eternal
Lo! He abhors not the Virgin's womb Son of the Father,
Begotten, not created.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Sing choirs of angels
Sing in exultation
Sing, all ye citizens of heaven above,
Glory to God in the highest

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Yea, Lord we greet Thee
Born this happy morning;
Jesus, to Thee be glory given
Word of the Father,
Now in flesh appearing

songs.title: O, dear Lord, we praise your name

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
O, dear Lord, we praise your name,
Forever be magnified;
We bless You, Lord; and worship You,
All power belongs to You.
Translation Awurade, yeyi
W’ayε, yεkamfo Wo daadaa nyinaa

songs.title: O’ God I come before You

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
O’ God I come before You
I cannot do without You
I need You every time so that I will be strengthened
Holy Spirit fill me to the brim that I will work in Your service
Holy Spirit fill me to the brim
Use me now and evermore.

songs.title: O God, our help in ages past

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Our shelter from the stormy blast
And our eternal home.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Under the shadow of Thy throne
Thy saints have dwelt secure;
Sufficient is Thine arm alone,
And our defence is sure.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Before the hills in order stood
Or earth received her frame
From everlasting Thou art God
To endless years the same.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
A thousand ages in Thy sight
Are like an evening gone,
Short as the watch that ends the night
Before the rising sun.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
The busy tribes of flesh and blood
With all their cares and fears,
Are carried downward by the flood,
And lost in flowing years.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Time like an ever rolling stream,
Bears all its sons away;
They fly forgotten, as a dream
Dies at the opening day.

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.content:
O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come,
Be thou our guard while troubles last
And our eternal home.

songs.title: O Halleluia! we bless your Holy name

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
O Halleluia! we bless your Holy name
O, Halleluia! we worship thee
O Lord
When we look upon thine throne
How wonderful you are
O, Halleluia! we worship thee
O, Lord

songs.title: O happy day, that fixed my choice

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
O happy day, that fixed my choice
On Thee, my Saviour and my God!
Well may this glowing heart rejoice
And tell its raptures all abroad

Happy day, happy day
When Jesus washed my sins away!
He taught me how to watch and pray
And live rejoicing ev’ry day.
Happy day, happy day
When Jesus washed my sins away!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
‘Tis done, the great transaction’s done!
I am my Lord’s and He is mine;
He drew me and I followed on
Charmed to confess the voice divine.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Now rests my long-divided heart,
Fixed on this blissful centre, rest;
Nor ever from thy Lord depart
With Him of every good possessed

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
High heaven, that heard the solemn vow
That vow renewed shall daily hear,
Till in life’s latest hour I bow
And bless in death a bond so dear.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
O Jesus I have promised
To serve thee to the end;
Be thou for ever near me,
My master and my friend:
I shall not fear the battle
If thou art by my side,
Nor wander from the pathway
If thou wilt be my guide

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.content:
O let me hear thee speaking
In accents clear and still,
Above the storms of passion,
The murmurs of self-will
O speak to reassure me,
To hasten, or control;
Oh speak, and make me listen

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
O Jesus, thou hast promised to all who follow thee-that where thou art in glory
There shall thy servant be;

And Jesus, I have promised to serve Thee to the end
O give me grace to follow, my master and my friend

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
O let me see thy footmarks.
And in them plant mine own;
My hope to follow duly
Is in thy strength alone
O guide me, call me, draw me,
Uphold me to the end;
And then in heaven receive me,
My Saviour and my friend.

songs.title: O Lord my God, when I in awesome wonder

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
O Lord my God, when I in awesome wonder
Consider all the works thy hand hath made
I see the stars, I hear the mighty thunder
Thy power throughout the universe displayed
Then sings my soul, my Saviour God, to thee
How great thou art, how great thou art!
Then sings my soul, my Saviour God to thee
How great thou art, how great thou art!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
When through the woods and forest glades I wander
And hear the birds sing
sweetly in the trees
When I look down from lofty mountain grandeur
And hear the brook, and feel the gentle breeze

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
And when I think that God his Son not sparing
Sent him to die - I scarce can take it in,
That on the cross, my burden gladly bearing
He bled and died to take
away my sin;

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
When Christ shall come with shout of acclamation
And take me home- what joy shall fill my heart
Then shall I bow in humble adoration,
And there proclaim my God,
how great thou art!

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
O magnify the Lord
For He is worthy to be praised,
O magnify the Lord
For He is worthy to be praised
Hosanna! Blessed be the rock
And may the God of my
salvation be exalted
Hosanna! Blessed be the rock
And may the God of my salvation be exalted

songs.title: O soul, are you weary and troubled?

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
O soul, are you weary and troubled?
No light in the darkness you see?
There's a light for a look at the Saviour,
And life more abundant and free!

Turn your eyes upon Jesus,
Look full in His wonderful face,
And the things of earth will grow strangely dim,
In the light of His glory and grace.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Through death into life everlasting
He passed, and we follow Him there
Over us sin no more hath dominion-
For more than conquerors we are!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
His Word shall not fail you-He promised;
Believe Him, and all will be well:
Then go to a world that is dying,
His perfect salvation to tell!

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
O, sweet wonder
O, sweet wonder
Jesus the Son of God
How, I adore you
O how, I love you
Jesus the Son of God

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Do you know Jesus
Our Lord, our Saviour
Jesus, the son of God
How I adore you
Oh how I love you
Jesus, the son of God

songs.title: O when the saints go marching in

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
O when the saints go marching in
O when the saints go marching in
O Lord, I want to be in that number
When the saints go marching in!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
O when they crown him
Lord of all
O when they crown him Lord of all
O Lord, I want to be in that number
When they crown him Lord of all.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
O when all knees bow at his name
O when all knees bow at his name

O Lord, I want to be in that number
When all knees bow at his name

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
O when they sing the Saviour's praise
O when they sing the Saviour's praise
O Lord, I want to be in that number
O when they sing the Saviour's praise

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
O when the saints go marching in
O when the saints go marching in
O Lord, I want to be in that number
When the saints go marching in

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
O worship the King
All glorious above,
O gratefully sing
His power and His love;

Our shield and Defender.
The Ancient of Days
Pavilioned in splendour,
And girded with prais

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
O tell of His might,
O sing of His grace,
Whose robe is the light
Whose canopy space

His chariots of wrath
The deep thunder-clouds form,
And dark is His path
On the wings of the storm.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Thy bountiful care
What tongue can recite?
It breathes in the air.
It shines in the light
It streams from the hills
It descends to the plain
And sweetly distils
In the dew and the rain

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Frail children of dust.
And feeble as frail;
In Thee do we trust.
Nor find Thee to fail:
Thy mercies how tender
How firm to the end

Our Maker, Defender.
Redeemer and Friend

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
O measureless might!
Ineffable Love!
While angels delight
To hymn Thee above.
The Humbler creation
Though feeble their lays.
With true adoration
Shall lisp to Thy praise

songs.title: O Ye sons of God, sing halleluia’

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
O Ye sons of God, sing halleluia’
To Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
He is King of kings and Lord of lords.
So sing Halleluia to the Messiah!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
All ye saints of the Lord, arise and shine
Your light is come through
Jesus Christ
He is Prince of peace,
Saviour wonderful;
So sing Halleluia to the Messiah!

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Lamb of Calvary , no sinful man,
He lived and died, for you and me;

There is victory for ever more!
So sing Halleluia to the Messiah!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Sing Halleluia! Shout
Halleluia!
Watch halleluia! Pray halleluia!
Dance halleluia! Everything halleuia!
So sing halleluia to the Messiah

songs.title: Oh, for a thousand tongues to sing

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Oh, for a thousand tongues to sing
My great Redeemer’s praise
The Glories of my God and King
The triumphs of His grace!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
My gracious Master and my God,
Assist me to proclaim,
To spread through all the earth abroad
The honour of Thy name

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Jesus! The name that charms our fears
That bids our sorrows cease;
'Tis music in the sinner's ears,
'Tis life and health and peace.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
He breaks the power of cancelled sin
He sets the pris'ner free;
His blood can make the foulest clean
His blood availed for me.

sections.label: Verse 5
Song
sections.content:
Oh glory! Oh glory!
What rapture is mine
The King in His beauty I see
I’m singing His praises
Since Jesus divine extended His mercies to me

songs.title: Oh, teach me what it meaneth

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Oh, teach me what it meaneth
That cross uplifted high,
With one-the Man of sorrow-
Condemned to bleed and die!
Oh, teach me what it cost Thee
To make a sinner whole;
And teach me, Saviour, teach me
The value of a soul! (x2)

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Oh, teach me what it meaneth
That sacred crimson tide-
The blood and water flowing
From Thine own wounded side
Teach me that if none other
Had sinned, but I alone,
Yet still, thy blood, Lord Jesus,
Thine only, must atone. (x2)

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Oh, teach me what it meaneth
Thy love beyond compare,
The love that reacheth deeper
Than depths of self-despair!
Yea, teach me, till there gloweth
In this cold heart of mine
Some feeble, pale reflection
Of that pure love of Thine (x2)

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Oh, teach me, what it meaneth,
For I am full of sin;
And grace alone can reach me,
And love alone can win.
Oh, teach me, for I need Thee,
I have no hope beside-

The chief of all the sinners
For whom the saviour died!

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
O infinite Redeemer!
I bring no other plea,
Because Thou dost invite me
I cast myself on Thee.
Because thou dost accept me
I love and adore;
Because Thy love constraineth,
I’ll praise Thee evermore!

songs.title: O the sweet and wonderful rest

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
O the sweet and wonderful rest
O the sweet and wonderful rest

Found in Jesus, in Jesus
Sweet and wonderful rest

songs.title: Oh, what a wonderful wonderful day

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Oh, what a wonderful wonderful day,
Day I will never forget,
After I’d wandered in darkness away,
Jesus my Saviour I met
Oh, what a tender, compassionate friend,
He met the need of my heart;
Shadows dispelling, with joy
I am telling

He made all the darkness depart!

Heaven came down and glory filled my soul
When at the Cross the Saviour made me whole;
My sins were washed away
And my night was turned to day
Heaven came down and glory filled my soul!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Born of the Spirit with life from above
Into God’s family divine;
Justified fully through Calvary’s love
Oh, what a standing is mine!
And the transaction so quickly was made
When as a sinner I came
Took of the offer of grace He did proffer
He saved me, Oh, praise His dear Name

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Now I’ve a hope that will surely endure
After the passing of time;
I have a future in Heaven for sure,
There in those mansions sublime
And it’s because of that wonderful day
When at the Cross I believed;
Riches eternal and blessings supernal
From His righteous hand I received

songs.title: On a hill far away stood an old rugged cross

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
On a hill far away stood an old rugged cross
The emblem of suffering and shame
And I love that old cross where the dearest and best
For a world of lost sinners was slain

So I'll cherish the old rugged cross
Till my trophies at last I lay
down
I will cling to the old rugged cross
And exchange it some day for a crown

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
O, the old rugged cross, so despised by the world
Has a wondrous attraction for me;
For the dear Lamb of God left his glory above
To bear it to dark Calvary.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
In the old rugged cross, stained with blood so divine
A wondrous beauty I see;
For 'twas on that old cross
Jesus suffered and died
To pardon and sanctify me

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
To the old rugged cross I will ever be true
Its shame and reproach gladly bear,
Then he'll call me some day to my home far away,
When his glory for ever I'll share

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
On the day of Pentecost
In the upper room
Where the saints had gathered

To tarry for the Spirit
Revival broke out
The Holy Ghost descended
And Peter preached
And three thousand souls were saved
Oh mighty revival, the power of the Spirit
The promise of the Lord has been fulfilled
And so revival broke out
The Holy Ghost descended
And Peter preached and three thousand souls were saved

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Onward Christian soldiers,
Marching as to war,
With the cross of Jesus
Going on before
Christ, the Royal Master
Leads against the foe;
Forward into battle
See His banners go

Onward Christian Soldiers!
Marching as to War
With the Cross of Jesus
Going on before

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
At the sign of truimph
Satan’s host doth flee;
On then, Christian soldiers
On to Victory!
Hell’s foundations quiver
At the shout of praise
Brothers, lift your voices
Loud your anthems raise.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Like a mighty army
Moves the church of God;
Brothers, we are treading
Where the saints have trod,
We are not divided
All one body we

One in hope in doctrine
One in charity.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Crowns and thrones may perish
Kingdoms rise and wane,
But the Church of Jesus
Constant will remain
Gates of hell can never
‘Gainst that church prevail;
We have Christ’s own promise and that cannot fail.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Onward then, ye people
Join our happy throng
Blend with ours your voices
In the triumph song
“Glory, laud and honour,
Unto Christ the King”
This, through countless ages,
Men and angels sing.

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
Open my eyes, Lord
I want to see Jesus.
To reach out and touch him
And say that I love Him
Open my ears, Lord
And help me to listen
Open my eyes, Lord
I want to see Jesus

songs.title: Our mighty tower is the Lord

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
Our mighty tower is the Lord
Our mighty tower is the Lord
Our mighty tower is the Lord
Our mighty tower is the Lord
He’s been our shield and hiding Place;
Our mighty tower is the Lord.
Translation of “Yεn abankεse ne
Yehowa”

songs.title: Out of my bondage, sorrow, and night

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Out of my bondage, sorrow, and night,
Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into thy freedom, gladness, and light,
Jesus, I come to Thee;
Out of my sickness into thy health
Out of my want and into thy wealth,
Out of my sin and into thyself,
Jesus, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Out of my shameful failure and loss,
Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into the glorious gain of Thy cross
Jesus, I come, to Thee;
Out of earth’s sorrows into Thy balm,

Out of my want and into thy wealth
Out of life’s storms and into Thy calm,
Jesus, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Out of unrest and arrogant pride
Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into Thy blessed will to abide,
Jesus, I come to Thee;
Out of myself to dwell in Thy love
Out of despair into raptures above,
Upward for aye on wings like a dove,
Jesus, I come to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Out of the fear and dread of the tomb,
Jesus, I come, Jesus, I come;
Into the joy and light of my home
Jesus, I come, to Thee;
Out of the depths of ruin untold
Into the peace of Thy sheltering
fold,
Ever Thy glorious face to behold
Jesus, I come to Thee.

songs.title: Over the river they call me

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Over the river they call me,
Friends that are dear to my heart
Soon shall I meet them in glory,
Never, no never to part.

Over the river to Eden,
Home to their dwelling so fair;
Angels will carry me safely.
Jesus will welcome me there.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Over the river they call me,
Hark, ’tis their voices I hear,
Borne on the wings of the twilight,
Murmuring softly and clear.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Over the river, how lovely,
There is no sorrow nor night;

There they are walking with Jesus,
Clothed in His garment of light

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Over the river they call me,
Watching with glad, beaming
eyes;
Over the river I’m coming,
Joyful my spirit replies.

songs.title: Pass me not, O gentle Saviour

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Pass me not, O gentle Saviour
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling
Do not pass me by

Saviour, Saviour
Hear my humble cry;
While on others Thou art calling.
Do not pass me by

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Let me, at Thy throne of mercy
Find a sweet relief,
Kneeling there in deep contrition
Help my unbelief.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Trusting only in Thy merit would I seek Thy face,
Heal my wounded, broken spirit
Save me by Thy grace

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Thou, the spring of all my comfort,
More than life to me
Whom have I on earth beside
Thee?
Whom in heaven but Thee?

songs.title: Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Peace, perfect peace, by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus, this is rest

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Peace, perfect peace, with sorrows surging round?
On Jesus' bosom naught but calm is found.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Peace, perfect peace, with loved ones far away?
In Jesus' keeping we are safe
and they.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown
Jesus we know, and He is on the throne.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Peace, perfect peace, death shadowing us and ours?
Jesus has vanquished death and all its powers

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.content:
It is enough; earth's struggles soon shall cease,
And Jesus calls us to Heaven's perfect peace.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Pleasant are Thy courts above,
In the land of light and love;
Pleasant are Thy courts below
In this land of sin and woe,
Oh, my spirit longs and faints
For the converse of Thy Saints
For the brightness of Thy face
For Thy fullness, God of Grace!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Happy birds that sing and fly
Round Thy altars, O Most High!

Happier souls that find a rest
In a heavenly Father’s breast!
Like the wandering dove that found
No repose on earth around
They can to their ark repair
And enjoy it ever there.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Happy souls! Their praises flow
Even in this vale of woe;
Waters in the desert rise,
Manna feeds them from the skies
On they go from strength to strength
Till they reach Thy throne at length;
At Thy feet adoring fall,
Who hast led them safe through all.

sections.label: Verse 4

songs.title: Pour out your Spirit on me

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
Pour out your Spirit on me
Ignite your fire in me
Touch and make me anew
My Lord Jesus
Touch and make me anew
My Lord Jesus

songs.title: Praise God, from whom all blessings flow

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
Praise God, from whom all blessings flow,

Praise him all creatures here below,
Praise him above, ye heavenly host,
Praise Father, Son and Holy
Ghost

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
Praise Him, praise Him
Praise Him, Praise Him
Jesus, blessed saviour
Is worthy to be praised
From the rising of the sun
Unto the going down of the same
He’s worthy, Jesus is worthy
He’s worthy, to be praised
Praise Him, praise Him,
Praise Him, praise Him,
Jesus, blessed saviour
Is worthy to be praised

songs.title: Praise to the holiest in the height

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Praise to the holiest in the height,
And in the depth be praise:
In all his words most wonderful,
Most sure in all his ways.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
O loving wisdom of our God!
When all was sin and shame,
A second Adam to the fight,
And to the rescue came.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
O wisest love that flesh and blood
Which did in Adam fail,
Should strive afresh against the
foe,
Should strive and should
prevail.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
And that a higher gift than grace
should flesh and blood refine;
God’s presence, and his very self
And essence all-divine

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
O generous love that he, who smote
In man for man the foe,
The double agony in man
For man should undergo

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
And in the garden secretly,
And on the cross on high
Should teach his brethren, and inspire

To suffer and to die

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.content:
Praise to the holiest in the height
And in the depth be praise

In all his words most wonderful
Most sure in all his ways

songs.title: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Praise to the Lord, the Almighty
The King of creation!
O my soul, praise him, for he
is thy health and salvation;
Come ye who hear,
Brothers and sisters, draw near,
Praise him in glad adoration!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Praise to the Lord, who o'er all things So wondrously reigneth
Shelters thee under his wings, yea So gently sustaineth,
Hast thou not seen
All that is needful hath been
Granted in what he ordaineth?

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Praise to the Lord, who doth prosper
Thy work and defend thee!
Surely his goodness and mercy here daily attend thee;
Ponder anew
All the Almighty can do
He who with love doth befriend thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Praise to the Lord, who when tempests their warfare are waging,
Who, when the elements madly around thee are raging Biddeth them cease,
Turneth their fury to peace,
Whirlwinds and waters assuaging.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Praise to the Lord, who
when darkness of sin is abounding,
Who, when the godless do triumph, all virtue confounding,
Sheddeth his light,
Chaseth the horrors of night,
Saints with his mercy surrounding.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Praise to the Lord! O let all that is in me adore him
All that hath life and breath
Come now with praises before him!

Let the Amen sound from his people again
Gladly for aye we adore him!

songs.title: Praise, my soul, the King of heaven

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Praise, my soul, the King of heaven
To His feet thy tribute bring;
Ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven,
Who like thee His praise should sing?
Praise Him! Praise Him!
Praise the everlasting King

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4

songs.title: Praises to the Lamb of God

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
Praises to the Lamb of God,
Who shed His blood on the cross
To redeem my soul from sin,
For His heavenly home,
Thank You, Jesus
Praises to Thy name; (x2)
O my Lord deep in my heart
Render my thanks to Thee

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
Prepare me, Lord, prepare me,
Prepare me for Your work (x2)
Souls are perishing, their lives being destroyed;
Their walls are demolished,
Captured by their foes,
Prepare me for Your work.
Translation of Yε me krado na soma m’

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Preserve my life, keep me
Ever at Your feet to sit

Bind me to Your will,
Your will alone Oh Lord

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
The work of my salvation
You wrought before I was born

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
This divine call of mine
Tis a heavenly call

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
You’ve called me, Lord to be
Co-servant in your work

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Relieve me of my will
For in my will is death

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Purify my heart
Let me be as gold
And precious silver
Purify my heart
Let me be as gold
Pure gold

Refiner's fire
My heart's one desire
Is to be holy
Set apart for You, Lord
I choose to be holy
Set apart for You, My Master
Ready to do Your will

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Purify my heart
Cleanse me from within
And make me holy
Purify my heart

Cleanse me from my sin

Deep within

songs.title: Reign in me, Sovereign Lord, reign in me

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
Reign in me, Sovereign Lord, reign in me,
Reign in me, Sovereign Lord, reign in me
Captivate my heart,
Let your Kingdom come
Establish there your throne
Let your will be done!
Reign in me, Sovereign Lord, reign in me
Reign in me Sovereign Lord,
Reign in me

sections.label: Song
sections.content:
Rejoice in the Lord always
And again I say, rejoice,
Rejoice in the Lord always
And again I say, rejoice
Rejoice, rejoice
And again I say rejoice,
Rejoice in the Lord always
And again I say, rejoice

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Rejoice, the Lord is king,
Your Lord and king adore,
Mortals, give thanks and sing,
And triumph evermore;

Lift up your heart; lift up your voice,
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Jesus the Saviour reigns,
The God of truth and love
When he had purged our stains,
He took his seat above;
Lift up your heart; lift up your voice,
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice!

Verse

Cleanse me from within

sections.label: Verse 2

Jesus the Saviour reigns,
The God of truth and love
When he had purged our stains,

Lift up your heart; lift up your voice,
Rejoice, again I say, rejoice!

sections.label: Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.content:
Rejoice in glorious hope
Jesus the judge shall come,
And take his servants up

To their eternal home
We soon shall hear the archangel's voice
The trump of God shall sound, rejoice!
Charles Wesley - RH.195

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Rescue the perishing
Care for the dying
Snatch them in pity from sin and the grave
Weep o’er the erring one
Lift up the fallen
Tell them of Jesus
The Mighty to save
Rescue the perishing
Care for the dying
Jesus is merciful,
Jesus will save

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Though they are slighting
Him
Still He is waiting

Waiting the penitent child to receive,
Plead with them earnestly
Plead with them gently.
He will forgive, if they only believe

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Down in the human heart
Crushed by the tempter
Feelings lie buried that grace can restore
Touched by a loving hand,
Wakened by kindness
Chords that were broken will
Vibrate once more.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Rescue the perishing,
Duty demands it;

Strength for thy labour the Lord will provide
Back to the narrow way
Patiently win them;
Tell the poor wand’rer a Saviour has died
Fanny J. Crosby - RH 561

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Revive me, O Lord
Let Your Spirit lead me
So that I may know Your way
So that I will do Your will
Justice Nana Aggrey

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Revive Thy work, O Lord
Thy mighty arm make bare;

Speak with the voice that wakes the dead,
And make Thy people hear!

Revive Thy work, O Lord
While here to Thee we bow;
Descend, O gracious Lord descend,
Oh, come and bless us now!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Disturb this sleep of death;
Quicken the smouldering embers now
By Thine Almighty breath.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Create soul-thirst for Thee;
And hungering for the bread of life,
Oh may our spirit be!

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Exalt Thy precious name,
And by the Holy Ghost, our love
For Thee and Thine inflame
Albert Midlane Err:
F.J. Crosby - RH 246

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Rise now upon your feet,
Put on the armor of the Lord,
There is victory for you.
There is victory for those,
Who will fight the fight of faith;
A crown awaits those who endure,
And eternal rest with Him
P. B. Appiah-Adu
Translation of “S4re gyina w’anam4n so”

songs.title: Rise, shine, give God the glory

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Rise, shine, give God the glory,
Rise, shine, give God the glory
Rise, shine, give God the glory,
Soldiers of the Cross.

sections.content:
River of God,
Full of grace
Full of power and strength
Invitation to all
To come and swim

Swimming in the river
I am swimming in the river of God
Swimming in the river
Swimming in the river
I am swimming in the river of God
Opoku Onyinah

songs.title: Rock of Ages, cleft for me

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee!
Let the water and the blood,
From thy riven side which

flowed,
Be of sin the double cure;
Cleanse me from its guilt and power.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4
sections.content:
While I draw this fleeting breath
When my eyelids close in death,

When I soar to worlds unknown,
See thee on thy judgement throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in thee
A M Toplady

RH 341

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Saviour, blessed Saviour,
Listen whilst we sing,
Hearts and voices raising
Praises to our King;
All we have to offer,
All we hope to be,.

Body, soul, and spirit
All we yield to Thee.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Nearer, ever nearer
Christ, we draw to Thee,
Deep in adoration
Bending low the knee:
Thou, for our redemption,
Cam’st on earth to die;

Thou, that we might follow

Hast gone up on high

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Clearer still, and clearer
Dawns the light from heaven,
In our sadness bringing
News of sin forgiven;
Life has lost its shadows,
Pure the light within
Thou hast shed thy radiance
On a world of sin

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Onward, ever onward
Journeying o’er the road
Worn by saints before us,
Journeying on to God;

Leaving all behind us,
May we hasten on
Backward never looking till the prize is won

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Higher, then, and higher
Bear the ransomed soul,
Earthly toils forgotten,

Saviour, to its goal;
where, in joys unthought of,
Saints with angels sing,
Never, weary, raising
Praises to their King.
Golden Bells 25

songs.title: Search me, O God, and know my heart today

sections.label: Verse 1
Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.content:
Lord, take my life and make it wholly thine;
Fill my poor heart with thy great love divine
Take all my will, my passion, self, and pride,

I now surrender, Lord, in me abide.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
O Holy Ghost, revival comes from thee;
Send a revival-start the work in me
Thy word declares thou will supply our need
For blessings now, O Lord,
I humbly plead.
Edwin Orr - RH. 257

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
See the victory
Granted in Jesus’ name
We shall overcome
See the victory
Granted in Jesus’ name
We shall overcome
Surely, we shall overcome
Surely, we shall overcome
See the victory, we shall overcome
Rosina Aninkorah

songs.title: Seek ye first the kingdom of God

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Seek ye first the kingdom of God And his righteousness,
And all these things shall be added unto you,
Hallelu! Halleluia!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Halleluia!
Halleluia! Halleluia!
Hallelu! Halleluia!
Men shall not live by bread alone But by every word
That proceeds from the mouth of God Hallelu! Halleluia!

sections.label: Verse 3

Send us the Rain, Lord, send us the Rain,

Send us the Latter Rain.
Healing the sick and raising the dead,
Send us the Latter Rain;
We need the Rain, Lord, we need the Rain,
Send us the Latter Rain.

Translation of Ma yεn nsu no bi, ma yεn nsu
PH 166

songs.title: Show us Thy glory, O Lord

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Show us Thy glory, O Lord,
Show us Thy glory, O Lord;
Let the dew of heaven bring us refreshing
And show us thy glory once
more.
PH 118

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Simply trusting everyday

Trusting through a stormy way;

Even, when my faith is small
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

Trusting as the moments fly
Trusting as the days go by;
Trusting him what'er befall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
Verse 4

sections.content:
Sing unto the Lord a new song
Sing unto the Lord, all ye earth,
Sing a holy song from your

hearts
Oh Hallelujah, the Lord, is king,
Oh Hallelujah, Almighty king,
Oh Hallelujah the Prince of peace,
Wonderful, wonderful,
Wonderful is the Lord

Oh Hallelujah, the Lord is king

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Smile, my brother, smile
Though the days be long
Smile, my brother, smile
Let your heart be strong
Dark are the days we are passing through

I know a friend who will keep you through
And He’ll lead you all the while
And you’ll smile, smile, smile.

PH 80

songs.title: Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling
Calling for you and for me
See on the portal He's waiting and watching
Watching for you and for me.

Come home, come home,
Ye who are weary come home;
Earnestly, tenderly Jesus is calling
Calling, "O sinner, come home!"

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Why should we tarry when
Jesus is pleading
Pleading for you and for me?
Why should we linger and heed not His mercies
Mercies for you and for me?

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Time is now fleeting, the moments are passing
Passing from you and from me,
Shadows are gathering, death-beds are coming
Coming for you and for me?

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Oh, for the wonderful love
He has promised
Promised for you and for me

Though we have sinned He has mercy and pardon
Pardon for you and for me
Will Thompson
PH 282

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Sons of God, march forward
In the power of the latter rain
Sons of God, march forward,
For Jesus is ever the same,

Sons of God, march forward
We are more than conqu'rors in His Name
Sons of God, march forward,
In the power of the latter rain
RH 94

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Sowing in the morning,

sowing seeds of kindness

Sowing in the noontide and

the dewy eves;

Waiting for the harvest, and

the time of reaping

We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves!

Bringing in the sheaves!
Bringing in the sheaves!
We shall come rejoicing
Bringing in the sheaves! (x2)

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Sowing in the sunshine, sowing in the shadows
Fearing neither clouds nor winters chilling breeze
By and by the harvest, and the labour ended We shall come rejoicing, bringing in the sheaves!
Golden Bells 438

songs.title: Speak to me now, my God

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Speak to me now, my God
Speak to me now, my God
Lord
I have opened my ears for you
Speak to me now, my Lord
Speak to me now.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Fill me now my God

Fill me now my Lord

I have emptied myself for you

Fill me now, my Lord

Fill me now.

songs.title: Speak to me, Lord, speak, that I may hear

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Speak to me, Lord, speak, that I may hear
Your servant waits upon you
Longing for you to show me your ways
That bring me eternal life
If I daily keep your ways
And I am obedient to you,
I shall be like a vessel of honour prepared for every good work.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Speak to me, Lord, speak, let me hear you
My ears are itching for your word
Your word is full of power and might
Your word shows me your good path
If my ears are opened to you
And I am obedient to you
I shall be like a tree by streams of water yielding fruit in season

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Speak to me, Lord speak, let there be light
Your servant waits upon you
Waiting for your own good direction

That brings me light on my path
If I live in your light
And I am obedient to you,
I shall be like a light that shines to show the right ways in this dark world.

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Speak to me, Lord, speak, speak so sweetly
Your servant waits upon you
Longing for your word that is so sweet
Which soothes and comforts the heart
If I walk in your good path
And I am obedient to you
I shall be like a tasty salt on earth that heals the world of sickness

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Speak to me, Lord, speak, let me prosper
Your servant waits upon you
Longing for your very good statutes
For they would make me prosper
If your word dwells in my heart
And I am obedient to you
I shall be like a kinsman redeemer who brings life to his nation.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Speak to me, Lord, speak, to me in Christ
I am looking unto Christ
Fullness of Godhead in bodily form
Perfection manifests in Christ
If I lift Christ up on high
And I am obedient to you
I shall be like a true servant who draws all people to his Master

sections.label: Verse 7
sections.content:
Speak to me, Lord, speak, show me your way
Waiting on the Holy Spirit
I am yielded to the Holy Spirit
He 's the One who shows me your way
If I follow his leadings
And I am obedient to you
I shall be like a good mentor who shows your way to generations
Translation of Awurade Kasa by Opoku Onyinah

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Spirit Divine, attend our prayers
And make our hearts Thy home;
Descend with all Thy gracious powers.
O come, great Spirit, come.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Come as the light - to us reveal
Our need of Thee below;
And lead us in those paths of life
Where all the righteous go.

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Come as the fire - and purge our hearts With sacrificial flame;
Let our whole self an offering be To our Redeemer’s name

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
Come as the dew - and sweetly bless This consecrated hour
May barrenness rejoice to own
Thy fertilising power.

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
Come as the Dove - and spread Thy wings

The wings of peaceful love;
And let Thy Church on earth become
Blest as the Church above.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Come as the wind - with rushing sound And Pentecostal grace;
That all of woman born may see
The glory of Thy face
A Reed, RH 210

songs.title: Spirit of God, take full control

sections.label: Verse
sections.content:
Spirit of God, take full control
I surrender to your lead
So that I will what you will
And do what you do
Opoku Onyinah

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
Spirit of the Living God
Fall afresh on me
Spirit of the Living God
Fall afresh on me
Break me, melt me, mould me, fill me
Spirit of the Living God
Fall afresh on me.
Daniel Iverson
PH 54

songs.title: Stand up! Stand up for Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Stand up! Stand up for Jesus
Ye soldiers of the cross;
Lift high His royal banner
It must not suffer loss,
From vict’ry unto vict’ry
His army shall he lead
Till every foe is vanquished,
And Christ is Lord indeed.

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.content:
Stand up! Stand up for Jesus!
Stand in His strength alone;
The arm of flesh will fail you,
Ye dare not trust your own,
Put on the gospel armour,
And watching unto prayer;
Where duty calls, or danger,
Be never wanting there.

sections.label: Verse 4
Verse
sections.content:
Sweep over my soul,
Sweep over my soul
Sweet Spirit, sweep over my soul;
My rest is complete as I sit at Thy feet,
Sweet Spirit, sweep over my soul.
Rev. A. H. Ackley
Translation of B4 bra me kra do
PH 171

songs.title: Take my life, and let it be

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Take my life, and let it be Consecrated, Lord, to Thee,
Take my moments and my days,
Let them flow in ceaseless praise

sections.label: Verse 2
Verse 3
sections.content:
Take my voice and let me sing
Always! Only, for my King
Take my lips and let them be Filled with messages for Thee.

sections.label: Verse 4
Verse 5
Verse 6
sections.content:
Take my love; my Lord, I pour
At Thy feet its treasure-store;
Take myself and I will be Ever, only, all for Thee.
RH 582
Frances Ridley Havergal

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Tarry for the Spirit
He shall come in showers,
Energising wholly
All your ransomed powers;
Signs shall follow service
In the Holy Ghost,
Then the Church of Jesus
Prove a mighty host

On, then, Church of Jesus
Claim your Pentecost:
God shall now baptise thee
In the Holy Ghost

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Through all the changing scenes of life
In trouble and in joy
The praises of my God shall still
My heart and tongue employ.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Of His deliverance I will boast
Till all that are distressed
From my example comfort take,
And charm their griefs to rest

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
O magnify the Lord with me,
With me exalt His name;
When in distress to Him I called,
He to my rescue came

sections.label: Verse 4
sections.content:
The Hosts of God encamp around
The dwelling of the just;
Deliverance He affords to all
Who on His succour trust

sections.label: Verse 5
sections.content:
O make but trial of His love;

Experience will decide

How blest they are, and only they,
Who in His truth confide.

sections.label: Verse 6
sections.content:
Fear Him, ye saints, and you will then
Have nothing else to fear
Make you His service your
delight
He’ll make your wants His Care

songs.title: Through the love of God our saviour

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
Through the love of God our saviour,
All will be well;
Free and changeless is his favour,
All, all is well
Precious is the blood that healed us;
Perfect is the grace that sealed us
Strong the hand stretched forth to shield us All must be well.

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Though we pass through tribulation,
All will be well
Ours is such a full salvation ,
All, all is well
Happy still in God confiding,
Fruitful if in Christ abiding;
Holy through the Spirit's guiding;
All must be well

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
We expect a bright tomorrow
All will be well;
Faith can sing through days of sorrow All, all is well
On our father's love relying,
Jesus every need supplying
Or in living or in dying
All must be well.

sections.label: Verse 1
sections.content:
We are often tossed and driv’n
On the restless sea of time,
Sombre skies and howling tempest
Oft succeed a bright sun-shine
In that land of perfect day,
When the mists have rolled away
We will understand it better by and by

sections.label: Chorus
sections.content:
By and by, when the morning comes
When all the saints of God are gathered home
We’ll tell the story how we’ve overcome;
For We’ll understand it better by and by

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
We are often destitute of the things that life demands,
Want of food and want of shelter
Thirsty hills and barren lands,
We are trusting in the Lord,
And according to His Word,
We will understand it better by and by

sections.label: Verse 3
sections.content:
Trials dark on ev’ry hand,
And we cannot understand
All the ways that God would lead us to that blessed Promised Land;
But He guides us with His eye
And we’ll follow till we die

For we’ll understand it better by and by

sections.content:
Temptation, hidden snares
Often take us unawares,
And our hearts are made to bleed for many a thought-less word or deed
And we wonder why the test
When we try to do our best
But we’ll understand it better by and by

Who is on the Lord's side?

Who will be his helpers?

Who will leave the world's side?

Who will face the foe?
Who is on the Lord's side?
Who for him will go?
By Thy call of mercy,
By Thy grace divine,

We are on the Lord's side,
Saviour, we are thine!

sections.label: Verse 2
sections.content:
Not for weight of glory,
Not for crown and palm,
Enter we the army
Raise the warrior psalm;
But for love that claimeth
Lives for whom he died;
He whom Jesus nameth
Must be on his side;
By thy love constraining
By thy grace divine
We are on the Lord's side
Saviour, we are thine!

Not with gold or gem,
But with thine own life-blood

With thy blessing filling

Thou hast made us willing
Thou hast made us free
By thy grand redemption.
By thy grace divine
We are on the Lord's side
Saviour we are thine!

Fierce may be the conflict,
Strong may be the foe;
But the king's own army

None can overthrow,
Round his standard ranging,
Victory is secure,
For his truth unchanging
Makes the triumph sure,
Joyfully enlisting,
By thy grace divine,
We are on the Lord's side;
Saviour, we are thine.
